About Me

A change maker in the making — grounded in business, drawn to technology.

I am Hafiza Khatun, a student of Management Information Systems at the University of Dhaka, drawn to the space where business, technology, data, and people meet. My academic journey has shaped a lasting curiosity about how information and technology can solve real business problems — particularly in data analysis, artificial intelligence, digital transformation, finance, and business management.

Beyond the classroom, I've built experience through teaching, research, volunteering, and leadership — working as an educator, contributing to youth and social-impact initiatives, and exploring how technology and creative thinking can turn ideas into practical solutions.

"A day dreamer with a strong desire to learn, create, and make an impact."

A Milestone Worth Mentioning

Youth Led Innovation Labs — Save the Children

As team leader, I helped bring a community business idea to a national platform, competing among teams from across the country over 2021–2022. Our teams earned both a 1st Runner-Up and a 2nd Runner-Up Award, BDT 1,00,000 each in seed funding — recognised at the closing ceremony and covered by local Satkhira media.

Child Rights & Community Research

Starting young, with National Children's Task Force.

As a Child Researcher with NCTF Satkhira from age 14, I worked on identifying child-rights issues in my community and contributed to local awareness efforts — including raising concerns directly with the Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) on child-related problems in the area.
